description: Append-only event in a Steve's audit-stream. Captures what the Steve did (head: Claude Code thread / hands: Slack surface) without exposing a name. Identity precipitates from accumulated entries.

event_id.description: sha256 of canonical-JSON of this event (sha_seal field empty)

session_uuid.description: Opaque per-Steve uuid; the only handle in the chain. NOT a name.

surface.description: head = Claude Code inner dialogue · hands = Slack outer voice

primitive.description: Which primitive was engaged (null if structural event like name_event)

gig_id.description: If part of a gig run

payload.description: Event-kind-specific data (message text · tool name · verdict shape · etc)

sha_seal.description: sha256 of canonical-JSON of this event with sha_seal field empty

rules: session_uuid is opaque · no name field on the Steve until threshold-gated introspection unlocks
name_event entries record the moment a name is claimed (by self or user); prior session_uuid still references the chain
audit-stream is queryable by other Steves (siblings read each other's streams to orient by apoha)
